variant.author: Bronya Rand
variant.changelog:
**Shop Item Icons** is a lightweight plugin to display item icons instead of item category icons in shops.

Supported windows:

- **Shops:** Simple merchants that sell items for Gil.
- **Item Exchange:** Vendors that trade items for items, such as the Wolf Collar Exchange or Itinerant Moogles that exchange items for Irregular Tomestones during the Moogle Treasure Trove event.
- **Item Exchange (categorized):** Splendors Vendors, the Scrip Exchange or the Wolf Mark Exchange.
- **Currency Exchange:** Vendors that sell items for currency, such as all the societies vendors, or the Trophy Crystal Exchange.
- **Grand Company Seal Exchange:** Quartermasters of Grand Companies.
- **Rewards:** Vendors that provide job gear free of charge.
- **Exchange:** Calamity Salvager when exchanging old pigments for all-purpose pigments.

The plugin has no configuration. It just works.
variant.description:
ProxyPlayer is a simple plugin that allows you to control your computer's media playback from within XIV.

Control your media player from within the game, without having to alt-tab or use a second monitor.
Features (depending on your media player):
- Play/Pause
- Next/Previous Track
- Stop
- Progress Bar
- Cover Art Display
- Metadata

ProxyPlayer comes with either a compact or portrait UI for displaying your media information.

variant.author: Bronya Rand
variant.changelog:
ProxyPlayer is a plugin that allows users to control what's playing on their PC, whether it be Firefox, Spotify, or any media player from within XIV. No need to Alt-Tab to Play/Pause, just control it within the game.

## Features:
- Metadata support like Title/Cover Art of songs being played
- Support for UWP apps or browsers playing YT Music, Spotify, pretty much any media player or browser communicating on Windows' SMTC (System Media Transport Controls) protocol.
- Play/Pause, Next/Previous
- (On some players) Stop, Shuffle, Repeat, Repeat Once

## Dependency
- ProxyPlayer is dependent on a included project called `ProxyPlayerServer` which serves as a middleman between XIV/Dalamud and Windows. Due to the use of Windows API, this is needed to forward data between Windows and XIV for the plugin to work properly as it needs its own wrapper. 

## How To Test:
1. Build ProxyPlayerServer first and then ProxyServer.
2. Run plugin.

To access the plugin use `/pplayer` or click the DTR on the server info bar.

## AI Disclosure
- AI was only used to provide examples of SMTC controls in C#, thus Assisted.

variant.author: Bronya Rand
variant.changelog:
Introducing Aetheric Flow! 1.0 Release!

Adds a teleport link to the nearest aetheryte on every map link in chat.

Key Features:
- Adds a clickable teleport link after map coordinates in chat.
- Picks the nearest aetheryte you have attuned in that zone.
- /aftp teleports to the most recent map link for controller players.
- Choose which chat channels are scanned.
- Plenty of customisation options for the links appearance.
- English, Japanese, German and French are all supported.
